verdict.rationale: Sign-in method is a fair question for a government digital-administration portal like ANEF, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that the ANEF host serves a ~3 KB JavaScript shell with every transaction behind an account, and that the parent ministry site returns a Cloudflare challenge. Nothing documents whether the published sign-in path uses remotely completable credential MFA rather than biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a mailed PIN.
